relations.evidence: Jing-shen Tao (Chinese: 陶晉生; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Tô Chìn-seng; born 1933) is a Taiwanese-American professor emeritus of Chinese history at University of Arizona

relations.subject: Jing-shen Tao
relations.evidence: His father T'ao Hsi-sheng was a major scholar-politician during Republic of China (1912–49).

relations.subject: Jing-shen Tao
relations.evidence: He received a Ph.D. from Indiana University.
